# 🎨 Vaadin Flow Premium UI **Antigravity skills for creating stunning, modern Vaadin Flow UIs with React-level visual quality.** [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Apache_2.0-blue.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/Apache-2.0) [![Vaadin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vaadin-24.x-00b4f0.svg)](https://vaadin.com) [![Antigravity Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Antigravity-Plugin-8b5cf6.svg)](https://github.com/kdevultra/vaadin-flow-premium-ui) --- > **The problem:** AI-generated Vaadin Flow UIs tend to be functional but visually bland — default fonts, generic colors, no animations, flat layouts. They look nothing like what a React developer would expect from a modern web app. > > **The solution:** This plugin teaches AI agents to produce **stunning, premium UIs** in Vaadin Flow — with curated color palettes, Google Fonts, glassmorphism, micro-animations, responsive layouts, and dark mode — all in pure Java + CSS. --- ## ✨ What's Included | # | Skill | Purpose | Trigger | |---|---|---|---| | 1 | **vaadin-design-system** | Design tokens, Lumo theming, typography, color palettes, dark mode | Any Vaadin Flow task (mandatory) | | 2 | **vaadin-layout-mastery** | CSS Grid dashboards, AppLayout sidebars, cards, hero sections, responsive | Building layouts or page structures | | 3 | **vaadin-component-styling** | Premium Grid, Dialog, Form, Tabs, Button hierarchy, `::part()` styling | Enhancing stock Vaadin components | | 4 | **vaadin-animation-interaction** | CSS animations, transitions, skeleton loading, scroll effects | Adding motion or interactive polish | | 5 | **vaadin-premium-patterns** | 5 complete UI recipes: Dashboard, Login, Settings, Chat, Profile | Building full views or pages | | 6 | **vaadin-custom-components** | Custom Lit components with Java API bridges | When stock components aren't enough | ### Skill Dependency Graph ``` ┌─────────────────────────┐ │ 1. vaadin-design-system │ ◄── Foundation (always activated first) │ (Foundation) │ └──────┬──────┬──────┬─────┘ │ │ │ ▼ │ ▼ ┌──────────┐ │ ┌──────────────────┐ │ 2. Layout│ │ │ 3. Component │ │ Mastery │ │ │ Styling │ └────┬─────┘ │ └──────┬───────────┘ │ │ │ ▼ │ ▼ ┌────────┴─────────┐ │ 4. Animation & │ │ Interaction │ └────────┬─────────┘ │ ▼ ┌────────────────┐ ┌──────────────────┐ │ 5. Premium │◄────│ 6. Custom │ │ Patterns │ │ Components │ └────────────────┘ └──────────────────┘ ``` --- ## 🚀 Installation ### One-Command Install ```bash # Linux / macOS git clone https://github.com/kdevultra/vaadin-flow-premium-ui.git \ ~/.gemini/config/plugins/vaadin-flow-premium-ui # Windows (PowerShell) git clone https://github.com/kdevultra/vaadin-flow-premium-ui.git ` "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\vaadin-flow-premium-ui" ``` That's it! The skills are automatically discovered on your next Antigravity conversation. ### Manual Install 1. Download or clone this repository 2. Copy the entire folder to your Antigravity plugins directory: - **Linux/macOS:** `~/.gemini/config/plugins/vaadin-flow-premium-ui/` - **Windows:** `%USERPROFILE%\.gemini\config\plugins\vaadin-flow-premium-ui\` 3. Verify `plugin.json` is at the root of the plugin directory ### Verify Installation Start a new Antigravity conversation and ask: ``` Create a modern login page with Vaadin Flow ``` The agent should activate `vaadin-design-system` (foundation) and `vaadin-premium-patterns` (Glass Login recipe) automatically. --- ## 🎯 Quick Start ### Example Prompts Try these prompts to see the skills in action: ``` "Build an admin dashboard with Vaadin Flow — stat cards, data grid, and a sidebar" ``` → Activates: design-system, layout-mastery, component-styling, premium-patterns ``` "Create a glassmorphism login page with animated gradient background in Vaadin" ``` → Activates: design-system, animation-interaction, premium-patterns ``` "Style my Vaadin Grid to look premium with striped rows, hover effects, and badge renderers" ``` → Activates: design-system, component-styling ``` "Add skeleton loading animations to my Vaadin dashboard" ``` → Activates: animation-interaction ``` "Create an animated counter web component for Vaadin Flow" ``` → Activates: custom-components --- ## 🏗️ Design Philosophy ### CSS-First, Java-Second The single most important principle: **visual excellence in Vaadin comes from CSS, not Java**. ``` ✅ DO: Define CSS classes in theme files, apply with addClassName() ❌ DON'T: Use component.getStyle().set("color", "red") — unmaintainable ``` ### Layered Styling Hierarchy Always use the simplest approach that works: ``` Lumo CSS Variables ← Start here → Lumo Utility Classes → Component Variants → Custom CSS Classes → ::part() Selectors → Custom Lit Components ← Last resort ``` ### The React Parity Checklist Every generated view must pass these quality gates: - ✅ Custom typography (Google Fonts, not browser defaults) - ✅ Curated color palette (HSL-tuned, not generic CSS named colors) - ✅ Smooth transitions on all interactive elements - ✅ Responsive across breakpoints - ✅ Dark mode support - ✅ Consistent spacing via Lumo space tokens - ✅ Subtle shadows and depth - ✅ Micro-animations for state changes --- ## 📦 Skill Details ### 1. vaadin-design-system (Foundation) **Always activated first.** Establishes the design foundation: - Theme directory setup (`frontend/themes/{app}/`) - Lumo CSS variable overrides (colors, typography, spacing, shadows) - HSL-based custom color palette generation (50-900 scale) - Google Fonts integration - Dark mode (`[theme~="dark"]`) setup and toggle - `LumoUtility` Java-side utility classes Includes reference files: - `references/lumo-variables.md` — Exhaustive Lumo variable table - `references/color-palettes.md` — 3 pre-built premium palettes (Indigo Corporate, Emerald SaaS, Amber Warm) ### 2. vaadin-layout-mastery (Structure) Modern layout patterns: - **The Golden Rule:** CSS Grid for 2D structure, Flexbox for 1D alignment - `AppLayout` with styled sidebar (`SideNav`, dark drawer, glassmorphism navbar) - Dashboard grid (`auto-fit` / `minmax` responsive widget grid) - Card component with hover elevation - Hero sections with gradient backgrounds - Master-detail patterns - Responsive breakpoint strategies Includes examples: `DashboardLayout.java` + CSS, `SidebarLayout.java` + CSS ### 3. vaadin-component-styling (Enhancement) Transform stock components into premium UI elements: - Component variant reference (Button, Grid, Dialog, Tabs, Notification) - `::part()` shadow DOM styling methodology - **Button hierarchy:** Primary → Secondary → Tertiary → Danger → Ghost → Gradient - **Grid:** Striped rows, hover highlights, badge/progress/avatar cell renderers - **Dialog:** Rounded corners, backdrop blur, slide-in animation - **Forms:** Sectioned, 2-column responsive, validation states - **Tabs:** Animated underline, icon+text, vertical Includes: `references/shadow-parts.md` — `::part()` reference for 15 components ### 4. vaadin-animation-interaction (Motion) Bring UIs to life: - 12+ reusable CSS `@keyframes` (fadeIn, slideUp, pulse, shake, shimmer, spin, etc.) - Class-based animation triggers from Java (`onAttach` + `requestAnimationFrame`) - Skeleton loading / shimmer screens - Page enter/exit transitions - Scroll-triggered reveal (IntersectionObserver via `executeJs`) - Button interaction recipes (ripple, press scale, success checkmark) - Staggered list animations Includes: `examples/animations.css` (drop-in animation library), `examples/SkeletonLoader.java` ### 5. vaadin-premium-patterns (Recipes) Complete, production-ready UI patterns: | Pattern | Visual Highlights | |---|---| | **Admin Dashboard** | Stat cards with gradient accents, chart area, data grid with badge renderers | | **Glass Login** | Glassmorphism card on animated gradient background | | **Modern Settings** | Tabbed sections, toggle switches, save confirmation toast | | **Chat Interface** | Message bubbles, typing indicator animation, auto-scroll | | **User Profile** | Cover image, overlapping avatar, stat counters, activity feed | Each pattern includes a Java class + companion CSS file with dark mode and responsive support. ### 6. vaadin-custom-components (Escape Hatch) When stock components can't achieve the desired effect: - Decision tree: "Do you need a custom component?" - Lit component creation + Java bridge (`@Tag`, `@JsModule`) - Property/event binding patterns - `@ClientCallable` for server-client communication - Lumo theme integration inside Lit shadow DOM - 7 recipe sketches (animated counter, circular progress, sparkline, gradient text, confetti, ripple, toast) Includes: `examples/animated-counter.ts` + `examples/AnimatedCounter.java` (complete working example) --- ## 🔧 Requirements - **Antigravity** (Google Antigravity AI coding assistant) - **Vaadin Flow 24.x** (current LTS) - **Java 17+** --- ## 🤝 Contributing We welcome contributions! See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for guidelines on: - Adding new skills or patterns - Improving existing examples - Code style requirements (CSS-first, Lumo variables, no inline styles) - Testing your changes locally ### Ideas for Contributions - Additional premium patterns (e.g., Kanban board, file manager, onboarding wizard) - Vaadin 25 compatibility notes - Integration patterns for chart libraries (ApexCharts, ECharts) - Accessibility audit improvements - Additional color palettes --- ## 📄 License This project is licensed under the [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE). --- ## 🙏 Acknowledgments - [Vaadin](https://vaadin.com/) for the excellent Flow framework and Lumo design system - [Google Antigravity](https://github.com/google/antigravity) for the AI agent platform - The Vaadin community for design inspiration and best practices ---
